title: Storage Rental Delinquency and End-of-Rental Fee Schedule
content:
Overlock, cleanout and contents-holding figures are set per Storage Rental product as follows.

| Storage Rental product | Days a storage charge may stay past due before overlock | Overlock fee (placing and removing) | Cleanout fee (unit not left empty and broom-clean) | Contents left behind held after the end date (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bike Storage Locker | 30 | $35.00 | $25.00 | 15 |
| Small Storage Closet (4x4) | 30 | $35.00 | $50.00 | 15 |
| Standard Storage Unit (5x5) | 30 | $35.00 | $75.00 | 15 |
| Large Storage Unit (5x10) | 30 | $35.00 | $125.00 | 15 |
| Climate-Controlled Storage Unit (5x10) | 30 | $35.00 | $125.00 | 15 |
| Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) | 30 | $35.00 | $200.00 | 15 |

**Notes**

- One overlock fee of $35.00 covers both placing and removing the overlock, for every Storage Rental product.
- The cleanout fee rises with the product: from $25.00 for the Bike Storage Locker to $200.00 for the Oversized Storage Suite (10x10); the two 5 by 10 products share the $125.00 figure.
- The past-due period (30 days) and the contents holding period (15 calendar days) are uniform across the six products.
